segments.name: Seaborne Thermal
segments.description: Mines thermal coal for export from its seaborne operations.
segments.evidence: Segment and Geographic Information As of December 31, 2025, Peabody reports its results of operations primarily through the following reportable segments: Seaborne Thermal, Seaborne Metallurgical, Powder River Basin and Other U.

segments.name: Seaborne Metallurgical
segments.description: Mines metallurgical coal for steelmakers from its seaborne operations.
segments.evidence: The mine is expected to enhance both the quantity and quality of the Company's production from the Seaborne Metallurgical reportable segment.

segments.name: Powder River Basin
segments.description: Mines coal in the Powder River Basin for United States power generators.
segments.evidence: Segment and Geographic Information As of December 31, 2025, Peabody reports its results of operations primarily through the following reportable segments: Seaborne Thermal, Seaborne Metallurgical, Powder River Basin and Other U.

segments.name: Other U.S. Thermal
segments.description: Mines thermal coal at its other United States operations.
segments.evidence: Segment and Geographic Information As of December 31, 2025, Peabody reports its results of operations primarily through the following reportable segments: Seaborne Thermal, Seaborne Metallurgical, Powder River Basin and Other U.

revenueModel.text: Power generators and steelmakers buy its coal under supply agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, Peabody derived 25% of its revenue from coal supply agreements from its five largest customers.
